note: Fixed before any score was computed. Transparent formula, no ML. A change is a new version; every version's scores are published. The score says how much of an exchange's custody can be SEEN and PROVEN from outside — it is not a solvency rating and never a claim about an exchange.
range: 0..100, higher = more of the books are visible and proven, fewer warning signals

no_sourced_reserves.when: no published/labelled address list with a source URL (reserves shown as '—')

proven_shortfall.when: for ANY asset, the user-proven floor is larger than the on-chain reserve of that asset (both known); applied once

not_yet_proven.when: 0 accounts have recorded a verified balance proof on devnet

stuck_withdrawal_proofs.when: verified stuck-withdrawal proofs in the current epoch (none exist in v1 — always 0)

inclusion_failures.when: verified inclusion-check failures (none in v1 — always 0)

inputs_snapshot: every input value and its source file hash is written into evidence/score/<exchange>.json; verify recomputes the score from that file alone
pricing_use: cover annual rate = pool base + (100 - score) x 30 bps + utilisation / 5 (program constants)
